Song, playlist, or artist — which link?
All three work. A song link plays one track; a playlist link opens the list; an artist link opens the profile. Pick the one your audience should land on.
Does it open in the Spotify app?
On most phones, yes — tapping the scanned link offers the app if installed, otherwise it opens in the browser. Free accounts can open it too.
Is this the same as a Spotify Code?
No. Spotify Codes are the scannable barcodes inside the Spotify app. A QR code works everywhere — posters, print, packaging — with any phone camera, no Spotify app needed to scan.
